up: Retrieve exact activity values and molecular structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614544. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, standard activity type, standard value, standard units, and canonical SMILES. Filter for exact activity measurements only (standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL). Do not apply any additional filters on confidence scores, document types, or organism types. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614544' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
